description: Link to order a certified / sworn translation on the right PapeleoYa network site for Spain, Germany, France, Italy, Portugal, Sweden, Denmark, Norway or Finland, pre-filled with the language pair and document where that site supports it. The user uploads the documents and pays on that site; this tool never receives documents or personal data. Use it when the user wants to go ahead after a quote.

destination.description: Country where the translated document will be USED (submitted to an authority): Spain, Germany, France, Italy, Portugal, Sweden, Denmark, Norway or Finland. Name or ISO code, e.g. "Spain" or "ES".

has_apostille.description: The document carries an apostille / legalisation to translate.

source_language.description: Language the document is written in (code or English name).

target_language.description: Language to translate into. Default: the destination's official language.

name: start_order
title: Get the order link
